content: Hey, just checking in, do you need any support with logging your donation for the community garden fundraiser? We're updating the ledger by Thursday at noon, so timing's tight if you want to be included on this month's thank-you board.
I sent $120 yesterday from my Chase account ending in 0973. The transfer was to 'Westwood Neighbors Trust' with my full name, Daniel Rivera, and I used the reference code GARDEN23.

That's perfect, Daniel Rivera, $120 matches your pledge and the Chase account 0973 is already listed under your name. The reference code GARDEN23 helps us track it faster, especially since we're finalizing reports by midday Thursday.
Will I get a confirmation receipt emailed to daniel.riv@gmail.com or do I need to check somewhere else?

Your confirmation will go straight to daniel.riv@gmail.com once the bank clears the transfer, usually within 24 hours, but since the batch closes at noon Thursday, I'd keep an eye on your inbox tomorrow morning.
Okay, and the donation should show under my address at 44 Elmhurst Ave, right?

Exactly, your address at 44 Elmhurst Ave is tied to your donor record, so you'll see your name and contribution listed there for the community display. If there's any delay past Thursday at noon, your transaction ID CH0973-2211 will be the fastest way to verify.
Great, thanks for double-checking everything. I'll reach out if the receipt doesn't show up by tomorrow.

No problem! With your details, Daniel Rivera, Chase 0973, GARDEN23 reference, and your Elmhurst Ave address, you're all set. Let me know before noon Thursday if anything seems off so we can update before the deadline.
